legend: Pahom walks around as large an area as he wants, starting at daybreak and ending at sunset, using his spade to make markers as he goes. The polygon marked out by his markers as vertices represents the land Pahom has claimed.

Pahom walks at a speed of one metre per second, each marker cost m$$$m$$$ seconds to make, the total available time between daybreak and sunset is t$$$t$$$ seconds. Find the maximum area Pahom could claim.
Pahom must return to the starting point by the end.
input: The first line of input contains the number of cases, c$$$c$$$ (1≤c≤1000$$$1 \le c \le 1000$$$).

The next c$$$c$$$ line of input each consist of two space-separated integers m$$$m$$$ and t$$$t$$$ (1≤m,t≤108$$$1 \le m, t \le 10^8$$$) — the time required to make one marker, and the total time available to Pahom.
output: For each case, output a real number representing the maximum area. Your answers should have an absolute or relative error of at most 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$.

legend.ai: Pahom 从日出走到日落，想圈多大面积就圈多大面积，一路上用铲子做标记。以这些标记为顶点围出的多边形，就是 Pahom 声称占有的土地。
Pahom 以每秒一米的速度行走，每做一个标记需要 m$$$m$$$ 秒，日出到日落之间的总可用时间为 t$$$t$$$ 秒。求 Pahom 最多能占用的最大面积。
Pahom 必须在最后回到起点。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含测试用例数 c$$$c$$$(1≤c≤1000$$$1 \le c \le 1000$$$)。
接下来的 c$$$c$$$ 行输入中，每行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 m$$$m$$$ 和 t$$$t$$$(1≤m,t≤108$$$1 \le m, t \le 10^8$$$)——分别表示制作一个标记所需的时间，以及 Pahom 可用的总时间。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个表示最大面积的实数。答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$。
